legos.why: KEEP, under Kai's standard for one known word with two target words (K23: 'keep the clash, explain the sense in the presentation, and never let the marked sense be prompted without its context'). 'I know' is sé (S0059L01) and conozco (here). Growing conozco to its seed piece gives 'conozco a esas personas', 8 syllables and a rebuilt basket; and every one of its 8 rows already carries a person ('I know someone else'), so the bare prompt 'I know' never plays for conozco. Only the intro wording needs a look (not readable from here: a gap). S0230L01 is not-new and never played.
